annotations.title: Find the HS code for a product

description: Find the HS/HTS code for a product by describing it in plain words — the entry point to every tariff question. Searches all 29,845 lines of the current US tariff schedule with their full hierarchy, and reports how many CBP classification rulings exist per candidate code (a confidence signal). Example: "electric standing desk", "lithium battery pack", "frozen shrimp". No API key required.
name: hs_search
title: Find the HS code for a product
